lines.text: 1969. A computer at U C L A tries to send the word login to Stanford.
It gets out L, O... and crashes.
1971. Ray Tomlinson sends email between machines, and picks the at sign.
1991. Tim Berners-Lee puts the first website online.
1998. The fifty-six K modem standard. Homes dial in.
2005. Most home users have high speed, and video streams.
2007. The internet fits in your pocket.
Today, about nine in ten Americans carry one.
And this time, the whole word gets through.
